headline: Public petition on school flag display rules, boundary realignment, and grants of $521,064 and $236,835.
summary: The agenda covers a petition to set rules for flags on school grounds and the district boundary realignment report. It also includes several grants, donations, and policy reviews.
items: Executive session: collective bargaining strategy for Educational Association of Worcester units (A/B, Paraeducators, Therapy Assistants, Parent Liaisons)
Executive session: negotiation strategy for nonunion personnel, Administrative Clerk Kristi Turgeon
Student Advisory Committee items
Consent agenda: donation of 50 backpacks from UMASS Chan to Belmont Street School
Consent agenda: donation of sport/gym equipment and t-shirts for Belmont Street School field day
Consent agenda: donation of backpacks from Kids in Need Foundation to Belmont Street School
Consent agenda: donation of school supplies from St Mary's Parish valued at $4,209.00
Consent agenda: donation of $115.77 from Pledgeling Foundation to Worcester Technical High School
Consent agenda: memorial donations in memory of Joseph Alfego to Worcester Technical High School ($100, $100, $100, and $25)
Consent agenda: donation of 32 student desks from St. Spyridon Greek Orthodox Cathedral
Consent agenda: donation of $2000 from D'arren E Wuensch DBA A-Plus Education Services for used books
Consent agenda: donation of 200 pairs of gently used work boots from BRUNT for CTE programs
Consent agenda: donation of 1,000 elementary and middle school backpacks from Cradles to Crayons
Consent agenda: donation of 200 backpacks with school supplies from Coldwell Banker
Consent agenda: notification of new hire instructional and non-instructional staff, resignations and retirements, initial filing of recognition, and notices of interest
Public comment
Public petition c&p 6-14 (Michael Douglas) on flag display policy for school grounds and buildings, recommended for referral to Operations and Governance
Superintendent report: Welcome Back and Opening of Schools, recommended to approve and file
Boundary realignment report recommendations, held on a 3-0 vote
Filed on a 3-0 vote: review of magnet in school names (gb 4-92), magnet program scheduling at BMS/BHS (gb 5-21), and bus transportation distance change from 2 to 1.5 miles (gb 6-26)
Approval of Commonwealth Preschool Partnership Initiative (CPPI) Grant of $521,064
Approval of High Dosage Tutoring Grant from DESE, paid on a cost-reimbursement basis
Approval of Partnership for Reading Success Massachusetts (PRISM) Grant of $236,835.00
Approval of Computer Science Engage Grant of $27,831.00
Standing annual recognition of June and September as Pride Months (gb 6-94), recommended to approve and file
Update to Policy JCA on assignment of students to schools (gb 6-95), recommended for referral
Review of district voluntary transfer policy and decision criteria (c&p 6-6), recommended for referral
Review of policies ECAF, IHBG, and JFBB to align with student handbook (gb 6-96), recommended for referral
New Model Policy ACL on interaction with law enforcement officers under DESE guidance and the PROTECT Act (gb 6-97), recommended for referral
Second meal prices for 2026-2027 (gb 6-98), recommended to approve and file
Announcements: upcoming meeting dates in September and October 2026
location: Esther Howland Chamber, Worcester City Hall, also available via Zoom
